    def __init__(self, name, fn, interval_seconds, args=None, kwargs=None):

        self.fn = fn
        self.interval = interval_seconds
        self.args = args or ()
        self.kwargs = kwargs or {}
        self.last_run = 0
        self.run_count = 0
        self.error_count = 0
        self.last_error = None
        self.enabled = True
